echo: Have you seen Father Declan today?

lines.speaker: System
lines.text: Fr. Declan Tierney is not here.

lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
lines.text: I haven't set eyes on him yet this morning, though he's usually bound to pass by the crossroads before noon.

lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
lines.text: *A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron wipes a smear of soot from his forehead with the back of a scarred hand.*
